title: Wendell and the Deadline
author: Kestrel Yarrow
blurb: Sebastian Galloway, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
